title: Check consent before an outbound call
alias: outbound call consent and hours checks
summary: Check stored consent and the callee's local calling window before your code sends an outbound dial request.
scenario: A workshop that calls customers when their bikes are ready, and only the ones who asked

evidence: the platform mechanism is thin here: the claim is the ordering (consent check, then dial); pair with handle-opt-outs-yourself
tools/openapi/rest.json Calling.CallCreateParamsSWML required from, swml; the recorder proves no request precedes a refused check
